title: Is In-Context Reinforcement Learning A Posterior Sampler? An Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.28977v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) exploits the impressive in-context learning ability of large language models to zero-shot generalize to new, unseen tasks at inference time without any parameter updates. Among many approaches, the Decision-Pretrained Transformer (DPT) is particularly appealing for its theoretical grounding: under idealized assumptions such as a sufficiently expressive model and infinite pretraining data, DPT can perform Bayesian posterior sampling. Whether this characterization survives in practice remains open. translated_title: 上下文强化学习是后验采样器吗？一项实证研究
translated_abstract: 上下文强化学习利用大型语言模型令人印象深刻的上下文学习能力，在推理时零样本泛化到新的、未见过的任务，而无需任何参数更新。在众多方法中，决策预训练Transformer（DPT）因其理论基础而尤为引人注目：在模型具有充分表达能力、预训练数据无限等理想化假设下，DPT可以执行贝叶斯后验采样。然而这一理论刻画在实践中是否仍然成立仍是悬而未决的问题。因此，我们提出这样一个问题：上下文强化学习，具体而言是DPT和我们提出的DPT变体，在实践中是否是一个贝叶斯后验采样器？为了研究这一问题，我们建立了贝叶斯后验采样器必须满足的两个必要条件：充分统计量不变性和鞅性质。随后我们构造了统计假设检验，以统计方法评估实践中训练的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过建立贝叶斯后验采样器必须满足的两个必要条件——充分统计量不变性和鞅性质，并据此构造统计假设检验，实证考察了上下文强化学习（特别是DPT及其变体）在实践中是否真正表现为贝叶斯后验采样器。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically investigates whether in-context reinforcement learning, specifically DPT and its variants, behaves as a Bayesian posterior sampler in practice, by establishing two necessary conditions—sufficient-statistic invariance and the martingale property—and constructing statistical hypothesis tests to assess them.
